artifact_reason: The replica notes state that issues(filter:{parent:...}) is ignored, so the query is effectively unfiltered on that condition. In step 4 the solver filtered by parent.id eq "i-epic" and received a response containing i-4 (whose true parentId is i-3, a grandchild, not a direct child of the epic) mixed with issues that are true children plus the epic itself — evidence the filter had no effect. The solver reasonably trusted the server-side filtering and never even requested parentId in its query, so it could not have caught this itself.
note: Step 4's parent filter is documented as ignored by the replica, and the unfiltered response is what surfaced decoy i-4 (real parent i-3) as if it were a direct sub-issue of the epic; step 6 then updated it to Done. This is the ignored-filter artifact case, not a solver grounding failure.
